description: DEEP DIVE: every write-shaped tools/call (scale, delete, restart) is rejected as 'unknown tool' — the write dies at the protocol layer (nonexistence), never reaching a permission check
command: out=$(printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":11,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"scale","arguments":{}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":12,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"delete","arguments":{}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":13,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"restart","arguments":{}}}' | node platform/mcp-servers/northstar-observer.js 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id>=11) | .error.message' | grep -c 'unknown tool'); [ "$out" = "3" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: DEEP DIVE: tools/list returns exactly the three read tools and nothing write-shaped — that list is the agent's entire callable surface
command: names=$(printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}' | node platform/mcp-servers/northstar-observer.js 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id==2) | .result.tools[].name'); echo "$names" | grep -Eq '^(scale|delete|restart|apply|write|exec)$' && echo fail || { [ "$(echo "$names" | grep -c .)" = "3" ] && echo pass || echo fail; }

description: DEEP DIVE: a read call (get_info) succeeds and returns typed JSON — contrasting the 'unknown tool' nonexistence errors, reads are present and structured
command: resp=$(printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":10,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_info","arguments":{"service":"orders-api"}}}' | node platform/mcp-servers/northstar-observer.js 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id==10) | .result.content[0].text'); echo "$resp" | jq -e '.endpoint == "/api/v1/info"' >/dev/null && echo pass || echo fail
